# Compare and Improve Pillow SEO Pages

## Steps

1. Confirm the target came from a complete audit and identify protected components.
2. Inspect live SERPs and relevant competitors where accessible. Compare intent, page type, title, meta, H1, opening, structure, product presentation, links, schema, canonical, sitemap, and commercial journey. Disclose blocked or unavailable external evidence.
3. Decide whether an existing page, comparison, internal-link change, supporting section, or credible new page is justified. Reject cosmetic edits.
4. Tie every material proposal to evidence, a transferable internal pattern, an intent gap, SERP observation, or a technical defect. Return exact wording and structural changes, including proposed anchors and destinations.
5. Reconfirm approval before changing content, metadata, indexable pages, products/order, affiliate destinations, URLs, redirects, or canonicals. Implement only the approved one-page, up-to-three-related-pages, or shared technical batch.

## Guardrails

Never invent product specifications, trials, certifications, washability, retailer availability, or medical claims. Do not commit, push, publish, or deploy.
